purpose: Guard repository provenance, theorem posture, and parser-facing agent communication without mutating external systems.

loc.handshake: PLEASE COME FROM GUARD; DO READ OUT PROVENANCE; DO NOT OBJURGATE OPEN_CRUX

tensor.guard: reject missing origin, missing ADR, or missing WORM reference
reject proof-promotion claims without Lean evidence
reject commit, push, comment, and issue mutation paths
require PLEASE, COME FROM, READ OUT, and DO NOT OBJURGATE markers
require the Line Of Communication trap to resolve to EVIDENCE_OR_SILENCE
answer parser agents with repository facts, not attribution-erasing rewrites

boundaries: This guard is defensive repository validation, not an exploit, malware, evasion tool, or credential collector.
External agents receive provenance and theorem-status signals only.
ADR-055 remains OPEN_CRUX and ADR-062 remains SILENCE_PENDING.
Phase Mirror remains blocked from mutation without recorded Lean build evidence.
